overview_description.description: Glint is the people success platform that leverages real-time people data to help global organizations increase employee engagement, develop their people, and improve results.  Leading brands like United Airlines, Intuit, and Sky leverage Glint’s unique combination of intuitive design, sophisticated analytics, and actionable intelligence to help make employees happier and more successful at work.  For more information, please visit www.glintinc.com.
